facts.text: PiCAM loads the PICam shared library named by the PICAM_DLL environment variable with ctypes when the module is imported
read_param dispatches on the PICam parameter type and returns the value; an enumeration is returned as its short name and Rois as a list of ROI tuples
write_param sets integer, floating-point and enumeration parameters through the PICam C API
commit_parameters commits the parameter set and returns the names of the parameters that failed
The upstream exposure value is in milliseconds
The ScopeFoundry plug-in labels ExposureTime in ms and AdcSpeed in MHz
read_rois stores the returned ROI list on self.roi_array and returns it
write_single_roi writes one ROI_tuple through write_rois
acquire takes readout_count readouts and returns a flat uint16 array; ReadoutStride is treated as a byte count
reshape_frame_data reshapes the flat readout per ROI, dividing the ROI width and height by the binning
The readout measurement reads the ROIs, commits the parameters, acquires one readout and reshapes it per ROI
close closes the camera and uninitializes the PICam library
The cooling status enumeration values are Unlocked, Locked and Faulted
